summaries.text: I work across applied machine learning, NLP, quantitative research, and developer tooling. My current technical interests include LLM strategies and quality workflows, specification-first collaboration, repository stewardship, and practical compute environments. The through-line is turning an ambiguous technical problem into a system that can be examined, maintained, and discussed clearly.

Machine-learning engineer and technical lead with fifteen years across NLP, applied statistics, quantitative research, and software infrastructure. I turn ambiguous problems into maintainable systems, pairing rigorous modelling with practical delivery and clear communication across technical and operational teams.

I work on LLM strategies and quality workflows, repository stewardship, and practical technical environments. Fifteen years across data science, ML research, NLP, and developer tooling support a specification-first approach and clear technical decisions.
